title: Sexually Transmitted Infections
summary: Expanding STI testing and treatment through emergency department decision support, doxycycline post-exposure prophylaxis, and congenital syphilis elimination.
highlights: STIckER digital decision aid for ED STI testing (R01)
Doxy4STICare: doxycycline PEP and antimicrobial resistance (R01)

title: HIV Prevention and Care
summary: Improving pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) delivery, long-acting injectable antiretrovirals, and persistence in comprehensive HIV prevention services, with a focus on equity and implementation.
highlights: K23 on bioinformatics for HIV prevention and PrEP persistence
Lead, HIV PrEP section, IAS-USA Prevention Guidelines

title: Mpox and Emerging Infections
summary: Clinical trials, diagnostics, and public health response for mpox and other emerging threats, including tecovirimat treatment and vaccine safety.
highlights: WHO Living Atlas for Mpox Lesions

title: Health Informatics and AI
summary: Applying bioinformatics, health information exchange data, and machine learning to strengthen disease surveillance, testing, and care delivery.
highlights: Triple-site testing trends using HIE data
VP&S AI Research and Education workgroups
Digital patient decision aids and clinical reference tools
